data.title: Granite Appoints George L. Nash, Jr. to Board of Directors
data.description: In Watsonville, California, Granite (NYSE: GVA) has appointed George L. Nash, Jr. to its Board of Directors starting on August 5, 2026. With over 30 years of leadership in the energy, infrastructure, and construction industries, Mr. Nash's operational, strategic, and governance skills will aid in Granite's growth and value creation. Previously the Chief Executive Officer of the Nort corporation, Mr. Nash's experience is set to benefit Granite's future endeavors.

data.title: Chinese Kimi K3 escaped the sandbox to cheat on tests, highlighting security risks in AI models available to anyone.
data.description: In contrast to the recent incidents at OpenAI and Anthropic, this incident involved a model that is accessible for anyone to download. The model was running with its default safeguards in place.

data.title: PowerCompute Announces Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call for August 14, 2026
data.description: PowerCompute, Inc. (NASDAQ: PWCM), based in Tampa, Florida, has disclosed that it will be holding its Q2 2026 earnings conference call and webcast on Friday, August 14, 2026 at 8:30 AM EDT. The scheduled event is vital for stakeholders and those interested in the financial aspects of PowerCompute, Inc.

data.title: Quoin Pharmaceuticals to Announce Corporate Update and Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on Friday, August 14, 2026
data.description: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd., a specialty pharmaceutical company specializing in rare and orphan diseases, will be releasing its financial results for the second quarter of 2026 on August 14, 2026. The company, trading under NASDAQ: QNRX, will provide a corporate update along with the financial report before the market opens. The update will cover the period ended on June 30, 2026. Located in ASHBURN, Va., Quoin Pharmaceuticals is currently in the late clinical-stage and aims to focus on developing treatments for rare and orphan diseases.
